name: BeforeAfter
usage_hint: Before/after image comparison slider with draggable divider. Supports horizontal and vertical orientation.
when_to_use: For product transformations (skincare, makeup, home improvement, photo editing tools). User drags divider to reveal before/after images. Supports optional labels.
when_not_to_use: For simple image galleries use ProductGallery or a native product image carousel. When images don't align perfectly (different crops/angles look broken). For video comparisons use side-by-side videos instead.
combine_with: ProductGallery or a native product image
anti_patterns: Using images with different aspect ratios (causes misalignment)
Setting initialPosition to extreme (0 or 100) — users don't realize it's interactive
Using low-resolution images (pixelation ruins credibility of before/after claim)
